calibration_error_hypothesis.model: CE = CE_pcie + CE_thermal + CE_scheduler + CE_measurement + CE_model + epsilon
calibration_error_hypothesis.allocation_rule: Shares are preliminary engineering hypotheses; require discriminating ablation campaign to convert to measured model.

CE_pcie.mechanism: PCIe DMA roundtrip serialization latency (2.85 µs vs 0 ns monolithic on-die)

CE_thermal.mechanism: Host thermal throttling onset, junction gradient, and package thermal capacity

CE_scheduler.mechanism: Host OS CFS scheduling quantum jitter, context switches, and core migration

CE_measurement.mechanism: RAPL MSR quantization (1 ms) and INA226 PMBus sampling window discrete resolution

CE_model_residual.mechanism: Unmodeled cross-traffic, memory bus contention, and background OS noise

ablation_campaign_spec.purpose: Ablation campaign to convert [HYPOTHESIZED ALLOCATION] to measured decomposition model

probes.probe_pcie: PCIe ON vs PCIe Direct Memory Bypass (emulated local SHM ring)
probes.probe_thermal: Chilled active chiller (fixed 18°C die) vs uncontrolled ambient thermal ramp
probes.probe_scheduler: SCHED_FIFO real-time core pinning vs default Linux CFS scheduler
probes.probe_measurement: High-speed Keysight external current probe (100 kHz) vs RAPL MSR/PMBus polling

ablation_campaign_spec.transition_gate: [HYPOTHESIZED ALLOCATION] -> [MEASURED DECOMPOSITION MODEL] strictly upon completion of all 4 probes

scientific_verdict_statement: Zmrazený experimentálny harness reprodukuje STRONG_PASS pri kalibrovaných fyzikálnych parametroch (VHL_HC = 1.1516, CI_95% = [1.1408, 1.1624], IVR=0, ICR=0). Fyzická diskriminácia H0/H1 zostáva podmienená live FPGA acquisition (M4.1-B).
